receiptBasis.reuses: ProductReceiptBasis v1 (DX0): sourceRevisions, projectConfiguration, engineIdentity, hostIdentity, completenessState

rules: The comparator is official WebStorm as shipped, in its recommended/default mode, benchmarked with diagnostics and all required features enabled; a comparator configuration with diagnostics disabled is invalid and voids every measurement produced from it (JBT0-AC1).
An alternate service-powered mode is a separate recorded comparator row marked alternate; it never substitutes for the default row and the default is never weakened.

A pin value is either captured from the installed official product (captureState captured, with value and captureRoute) or absent (pending-capture, with the named owner responsible); there is no third state and a guessed value is never admissible.
A superiority evaluation may not rest on any pending-capture pin; the gate stays closed until every manifest pin the evaluation reads is captured.
Deleting or weakening a captured pin to dodge a non-regression condition is forbidden; a pin changes only through a new capture with a new captureRoute.
The manifest adds no second status store and no new receipt machinery; it binds the DX0 vocabulary.
Installation presence, protocol smoke, or a screenshot is not comparator evidence; the measured comparator product is the real IDE doing its required work.

ide.captureRoute: read from the installed product's About/build dialog through the JBT1H real-IDE harness

build.captureRoute: installed-product build number reported by the JBT1H real-IDE harness

plugins.slot: official Vue support plugin (id, version, bundled state)
plugins.captureRoute: installed-plugin list read from the running official IDE by the JBT1H harness

engines.slot: official TypeScript/language-service engine identity and version executing web-language support
engines.captureRoute: running-engine identity reported by the official IDE through the JBT1H harness

attestation.content: every comparator run attests diagnostics and all required features enabled; without the attestation the run is void (JBT0-AC1)

capturedProfile.captureRoute: exported effective settings of the measured official installation

corpus.binding: the pinned comparison corpus shared with the SuperiorityPredicate methodology: representative real projects and libraries plus adversarial cases, chosen before optimization (JBT0.3), with pinned revisions

population.captureRoute: corpus fixture set pinned by the JBT1H fixture driver; WSP1 owns the equal-work instrumentation consumed alongside it

comparators.note: recorded alternate service-powered official mode, if the measured product offers one; a full comparator row with its own settings and engine pins; never the default row and never a substitute for it

ide.captureRoute: read from the installed product through the JBT1H real-IDE harness

plugins.slot: plugins participating in the service-powered mode (id, version, state)
plugins.captureRoute: installed-plugin list read from the running official IDE by the JBT1H harness

engines.slot: engine identities executing in the service-powered mode
engines.captureRoute: running-engine identity reported by the official IDE through the JBT1H harness

settings.profile: the alternate mode's documented opt-in configuration

attestation.content: alternate-mode runs carry the same diagnostics-enabled attestation; a weakened alternate row is invalid (JBT0-AC1)

capturedProfile.captureRoute: exported effective settings of the measured official installation in the alternate mode

corpus.binding: same pinned corpus as the default row; comparator rows never differ by corpus

population.captureRoute: corpus fixture set pinned by the JBT1H fixture driver

extensions/jetbrains.note: no JetBrains adapter exists yet; extensions/ currently ships only the lapce and zed launchers. An adapter landing later is inert until its activation boundary and must update this row

packages/dx-harness/jetbrains.note: the dx-harness substrate exists without a jetbrains driver; JBT1H registers it

semanticEntry.note: the sole semantic entry for editor clients remains the native verter-lsp through the shared editor-client initialization contract; a second semantic engine inside the client is forbidden
